description.narrative: (Uganda): With $1,850,000 in FY 2021 funds, Defeat TB will provide technical assistance to the National TB program, USAID implementing partners, and focus districts to reduce Uganda's TB burden and contribute to the U.S. Government and World Health Organization's End TB Strategy, which seeks to end the global TB epidemic by 2035. The activity works directly with the Ministry of Health leadership to address the high TB burden in Uganda and focuses on finding missing TB cases through effective community and facility-based interventions. .The activity will partner with other U.S. Government-supported TB and HIV partners. This coordination includes: providing support to the National TB Leprosy program to improve the quality of the current Multi Drug-Resistant-TB program, developing and implementing strategies that mitigate impact of COVID-19, increasing screening and detection of all forms of TB, improving early treatment initiation and successful treatment completion, and strengthening community systems to support the continuum of prevention, diagnosis, and treatment. .
